meta.title: 领导布置任务只说好的不够｜复述确认法
meta.title_en: Restate the Task: Never Just Say 'OK'

scenes.context: 讲者开场：新员工培训的职场经验，没人正式提过就可能中招。
sentences: 不管你工作多少年，都可能中招。
No matter how many years you've worked, you can still fall for this.
中招：fall for this trap
领导布置任务，你只说「好的」是不够的。
When your boss assigns a task, a mere 'OK' is not enough.
只说好的：just saying OK
一定要用自己的话，再复述确认一遍。
You must restate it in your own words to confirm.
复述确认：restate to confirm
paraphrase: Just saying OK leaves too much room for error.
scenes.speak: No matter how many years you've worked, you can still fall for this. When your boss assigns a task, a mere 'OK' is not enough. You must restate it in your own words to confirm.

scenes.context: 讲者用「准备会议室接待大客户」演示正确复述话术。
sentences: 领导说：把会议室准备下，明天大客户要来签合同。
Your boss says: prepare the meeting room; a big client is coming to sign a contract tomorrow.
大客户签合同：a big client signs a contract
我要做的是定最大的会议室，3 点到 5 点。
What I'll do is book the biggest room, 3 to 5 PM.
定最大的会议室：book the biggest room
合同打印一式两份，再准备些茶水糕点。
Print two copies of the contract and prepare some refreshments.
一式两份：two copies
这样做就可以了，对吧，领导？
That's what I'll do — right, boss?
确认语气：right, boss
paraphrase: 复述=清单化 → 可执行
Restating turns a vague order into an action list.
Filling in details is part of your job.
scenes.speak: Your boss says: prepare the meeting room; a big client is coming to sign a contract tomorrow. What I'll do is book the biggest room, 3 to 5 PM. Print two copies of the contract and prepare some refreshments. That's what I'll do — right, boss?

scenes.title_cn: 双向价值：领导放心，自己免责
scenes.title_en: Win-win: reassure the boss, protect yourself
scenes.context: 讲者从领导视角与自我视角解释复述的价值。
sentences: 复述细节，是下属表达尊重。
Restating details is how you show respect to your boss.
表达尊重：show respect
让领导一切尽在掌握，领导都喜欢这样的下属。
It keeps your boss fully in control — and bosses love that.
尽在掌握：in full control
万一搞砸了，锅没那么容易甩过来。
If things go wrong, the blame is much harder to pin on you.
甩锅：pin the blame
paraphrase: 领导视角 → 尊重与掌控
From the boss's view, it means respect and control.
自我视角 → 负责与免责
From your view, it means accountability and protection.
scenes.speak: Restating details is how you show respect to your boss. It keeps your boss fully in control — and bosses love that. If things go wrong, the blame is much harder to pin on you.

practice: Let me restate the task in my own words.
I'll book the room and print two copies of the contract.
Is that what you need, boss?
Confirming details keeps the blame off me.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Say good is not enough.
✓ 地道说法：A mere 'OK' is not enough.
✕ 直译腔：The boss's pot is not easy to throw over.
✓ 地道说法：The blame is hard to pin on you.
pin the blame 是固定表达。
✕ 直译腔：Print the contract two shares.
✓ 地道说法：Print two copies of the contract.
✕ 直译腔：Let boss all in the palm.
✓ 地道说法：Keep your boss fully in control.
shifts: 把复述当作「负责与尊重」
通过复述让结果可追溯
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词已按语境校正（如「精在张网」按上下文校正为「尽在掌握」）。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
